data.action: 坐在泳池边双腿浸入水中，晶莹水珠挂在皮肤
data.description: 【绫波丽 · 蔚蓝水波与纯白泳装】午后静谧的室内游泳池，清澈碧蓝的池水泛着潋滟的水波纹。绫波丽穿着纯白连体泳装坐在泳池边缘，双足轻垂入水激起细小的水花，晶莹的水珠沿着她如羊脂玉般白皙的锁骨与修长双腿缓缓滑落——「水很凉……但浸入水中的感觉，就像回到了最初的母体一样宁静。」
data.lighting: 池水折射的波光水影与明亮天窗漫射光
data.promptProse: Rei sits at the indoor pool edge in a plain white athletic swimsuit, letting her feet stir small ripples in the clear blue water. Her quiet gaze remains forward in the eye-level cowboy view. Pool lanes extend behind her beneath bright skylights. Diffuse afternoon light illuminates her blue hair and swimsuit fabric, while refracted water patterns move along the coping and softly reflect under her resting hands.
data.title: 绫波丽 · 蔚蓝水波与纯白泳装
